description: This file provides a PEAR DB emulation layer for the ADOdb database abstraction library in PHP. It includes constant definitions, a main DB class with static methods for database connection and error handling, and configuration setup, as well as includes for external dependencies.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for database connection management, error handling, DSN parsing, and extension loading.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a new database connection object based on the specified database type.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using a DSN or configuration array, returning a connection object or error.

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses a Data Source Name string into its components such as username, host, database, etc.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a PEAR_Error or DB_Error object.

methods.name: isWarning
methods.description: Stub method; currently always returns false, intended to check for warning objects.

methods.name: apiVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the DB API being used.

methods.name: assertExtension
methods.description: Loads a PHP database extension if it is not already loaded.
